moulin-rouge-2019.notes: Moulin Rouge! The Musical opened July 2019 at the Al Hirschfeld Theatre, was capitalized at $28 million, and recouped its full investment by July 2023 per Deadline and Broadway News. The show is scheduled to close August 2026, representing a run of roughly 7 years — significant but not the decade-plus phenomenon required for Miracle designation. No source reports a specific return multiple (e.g., 1.5x or 2x) that would qualify it as a Windfall or Trickle, so Recouped is the appropriate designation.
